voxvelo_fitness.setup.title: Set up VoxVelo Fitness
voxvelo_fitness.setup.explanation: Fitness needs Fitness Library %s for trainers, sensors and ride recording. Keyboard cycling is available without it.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.consent: Download and install the matching library from the official VoxVelo GitHub release? It includes native Bluetooth support. Restart Minecraft after installation.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.wrong_version: Library %s is installed. Close Minecraft and remove it from the mods folder, then install the matching version using the release page.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.ready: Nothing is downloaded until you click Download and install.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.downloading: Downloading and checking the library. Please keep Minecraft open.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.restart: Installed successfully. Quit and relaunch this instance to enable fitness features.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.exists: A library file already exists in the mods folder. Restart Minecraft, or inspect that file before trying again. It has not been overwritten.
voxvelo_fitness.setup.failed: Installation failed: %s Try again, or download the matching library from the release page.
